_about: Posts for the top of Today for you on the Dashboard (assets/today.js). Scottie tells Claude in chat, Claude adds an entry here and pushes. kind: drop (gold, a deal) or update (blue, news or app update). for: all, pro or ohana (others see a locked teaser that points to Plans). start/ends: YYYY-MM-DD, Hawaii days; no ends = up 7 days. link: a Dashboard page like #atmos or #plans, or an https link on hawaiirewardtravel.com. The newest live post wins over an older one, including a Squarespace post tagged drop.
